name: leodeim vpsmon
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed self-hosted Linux VPS monitoring dashboard with live CPU, RAM, swap, disk, network, Docker container and process metrics; no software quota or expiry.
watch_out: Runs on your own Linux VPS; hosting, bandwidth and optional domain/TLS infrastructure are not included. Protect the web dashboard with a bcrypt password and HTTPS; disabling authentication or exposing port 8088 publicly increases risk. Separate vpsmon.cloud multi-server service is not included.
